staticText: Private one-currency study-abroad cost worksheet using only user-entered assumptions checked against dated sources. It calculates full-route cost, first-year cost, confirmed aid, funding gap and upfront cash from tuition, duration, one-time costs and monthly living periods. It does not supply hard-coded foreign-exchange rates or destination averages, and it does not predict admission, visa approval, proof-of-funds acceptance, employment or affordability.
